verdict.rationale: Docs describe a review engine that surfaces ranked findings with rationale and fixes (qodo-docs-2, qodo-docs-3) and even flags risk/blast-radius for deeper triage (qodo-docs-8), implying more than style nits, but no evidence shows concrete examples of catching logic errors, race conditions, or edge-case bugs. One community comment reports a user dropping Qodo for a competitor after two years (qodo-comm-1), suggesting real-world doubts about review quality, though it's not a concrete documented failure. missing for 10: hands-on or third-party examples of Qodo catching specific logic/race-condition bugs, benchmark/accuracy data comparing to human reviewers.
